messages.subject: morphol.disparity() P-values
parts:
Hello everyone,

I want to compare variance of shape at different developmental stages in pairwise manner to see if there is difference in variance between them.

Code I used looks similar to this:
morphol.disparity(coords~stage, groups = stage , iter = 999)

where function returns Procrustes variance for each group, pairwise absolute differences and the P-values obtained from permutation tests. To my understanding, this way I am comparing the spread of coordinates from the mean of their corresponding stage.

I am uncertain do I compare the obtained P-values to the threshold of 0.05 or I should perform adjustment for multiple testing based on the number of stages I have. Any insight is welcome!

Kind regards,
Marko

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] morphol.disparity() P-values
parts:
It is fairly common to consider comparing the observed significance level of pairwise comparisons to an adjusted value, to account for the fact that one is performing repeated analyses of portions of the data.

 

Dean
